The first name '''Jon''', and its derivatives, can refer to the following people:

*[[Jon (blacksmith)|Jon]] - a blacksmith in the village of [[Jarra (village)|Jarra]].
*[[Jon Ayellin]] - a [[Two Rivers]] resident.
*[[Jonneth Dowtry]] - an [[Asha'man]] [[Soldier (Asha'man)|Solder]] from the Two Rivers.
*[[Jon Gaelin]] - another Two Rivers resident.
*[[Jon Skellit]] - a barber in [[Caemlyn]].
*[[Jon Thane]] - a miller from [[Emond's Field]].
